label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated preparations for tomorrow's great-hall civic presentation of thanks, possibly a larger surprise gathering with bread and lighting. Innkeeper arranged the event and insists on arrival only after setup; builder paid baker materials for forty-four loaves, whose purpose baker declined to disclose. Secretary knowingly assists scheduling; freight carried bread into the hall, though its connection is unconfirmed. The presentation itself was disclosed, but the full arrangements have not been.
